reviews.comment: As someone who bad w/ public speaking, I enjoy how Kyra formatted this class. The assignments were all very clearly explained and she gives feedback on everything. I do think her grading is rigid, but in an accurate way. Like if you visibly didn't practice your speech and disregard her notes, you get a bad grade, but she doesn't expect perfection.

This class was not an easy class. Although there are a lot of easy grades such as the attendance and if you participate, if you skip class, you will not pass. She does not care if you skip class either. If you do not participate, don't bother taking the class. Tests are in person and open note which is nice. I would not take her unless you have to.

Prof Heatly wasn't bad this class is just a lot of work. Lots of work outside of class yet very few grades (she grades hard). You will be assigned groups at the beginning of the semester and will work with them the entire time. Attendance is mandatory, you get 3 unexcused absences until she drops a letter grade
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Nice professor, just would make things more difficult than they needed to be. Exams were harder than they should have been, and she grades papers and group work hard too. Manageable to get an A though if you really try. She will give feedback before your turn in major assignments though, so do that. 2 exams, a long group project, discussion, paper.

Kyra is a grad student herself so she is very understanding and always willing works with students. Shes very accessible outside of class, her lectures were interesting and attendance is 100% mandatory. One of my fav profs at a&m

Kyra is super laid back. Her lectures are fun and engaging. There's a semester long group project but it wasn't too bad. Probably depends on the group you get. You make your own tests which was just time consuming. Prof is easy to go to and helpful. If you can take a class with Kyra do it. This was my second class with her and she's the best.

Go to the office hours. The only reason I received an A in the course is because I went to every office hour, she makes you work for a good grade. So apply every criticism given and follow the rubric's closely. She is very caring and knows what she is talking about so be open new ideas.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I took the 2 week course and needless to say, fitting a semester's worth of work in 12 days is rough. Kyra was very quick to respond to questions and messages which I applaud, and she was very friendly. However I never received the grade I expected to receive on a speech. If you mess up bad on the 3rd or 4th speech your grade really can't recover.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: I took COMM203 as a 2 week minimester this summer. Although it was a TON of work in a short amount of time, she graded pretty leniently and made expectations clear. There was work due everyday, but she organized it into folders so you were never confused of what to complete. She was very accessible over email and groupme, and overall very friendly!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Heatly was nice and gave good feedback. Her instructions were clear and she usually stuck to the syllabus. There were some assigned readings and quizzes, but it shouldn't be too tough. Attendance matters!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: It's a public speaking class so the entire course is writing speeches and delivering them. Kyra was a lot of help over the semester and wanted students to succeed. She made herself very accessible to us out of class and responded quickly to emails. If you do the work and read her feedback you should 100% get an A in the class.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.
